title: CARET end_to_end_sample, single-host ROS 2 instrumented software trace
creator: TIER IV / CARET contributors
release_context: 2022-07-05 commit replacing sample results for CARET v0.2.3. The same CTF bytes remain in the inspected current tree a4d8bf89c6015797d3e4890a7ccc2542822b6282.

rights.scope: Repository includes the example CTF trace; this package contains independently produced timing summaries, relative event times, documentation and verification code.

evidence_level: Decoded all 2,880 LTTng userspace trace events. A real execution of a reference software workload, one host and one process using a multithreaded executor and rmw_cyclonedds_cpp. Dummy sensor and actuator, with code-inserted sleeps and no physical hardware acquisition or actuation event. The selected five topics exclude parameter-events and other infrastructure.

application_code.evidence: SensorDummy sets header.stamp to now() just before publishing an empty Image, following an artificial sleep. Filter and downstream nodes forward its stamp. A timer republishes the last cached message; ActuatorDummy sleeps and discards the payload. The drive topic provides a separate trigger, not the original sensor sample.

linkage: Identify topic, publisher, subscriptions and callback handles from initialization. Build (topic,DDS source_stamp) using ordered rclcpp_publish and dds_bind_addr_to_stamp for the currently outstanding (thread,message buffer) pair. Dispatch carries DDS source_stamp and payload header message_timestamp. Check the header agrees and join dispatch, start and end using the callback handle and thread. The origin-topic nonzero header stamp is unique per publication, allowing final-topic callbacks to retain lineage across node boundaries and repeated republishes. Reused memory addresses are scoped to pending events.
clock_and_scope: Duration arithmetic uses only Babeltrace event-clock nanoseconds from this one-host trace. ROS payload stamps and DDS source stamps are treated as equality keys; no cross-clock subtraction. In the updates CSV all times use the first /topic1 publication as origin. Publish-to-callback-start covers middleware, scheduling and code; it is not network-only transmission delay. Software age uses first recorded publication as a generation proxy and callback start as an availability proxy. ActuatorDummy never issues a physical command. Trace closure can account for missing messages, so counts are not a packet-loss rate.
reproduction: Python 3 standard library plus Babeltrace 2 (verified using 2.0.4). Check out the pinned repository or download the 25 listed CTF and index files keeping their relative paths. Run python derive_caret_trace.py CHECKOUT OUTPUT. --babeltrace2 PATH overrides the executable. Retain decimal-second output at nanosecond precision. Actual operating-system, host, thread, and address identifiers are absent from derived CSVs.

search_log.search: TIER IV caret_demos sample end_to_end_sample and history of CTF metadata
search_log.outcome: Fixed trace introduction commit, all 25 trace inputs matched their Git blob, and historical program and architecture files were checked.
Release author describes trace as a simple validation/test fixture; no mobile-robot claim or additional dataset counted.

coverage_and_checks.execution: One trace only. All 47 /topic4 callbacks have a DDS-stamp-paired final publish and a source header linked to /topic1. Out of 49 original software sensor publications 40 different headers appear in sink callbacks. Seven repeats are new final-topic DDS publications carrying a previously received origin. A /topic2 publish with a DDS stamp lacks a corresponding callback in the trace, and one /topic3 rclcpp_publish lacks a DDS binding. No reason is imputed to either unmatched event.
coverage_and_checks.age_definition: At time t retain the maximum origin publication time over sink callbacks started by t. Integrate t minus this freshest origin over the first-to-last callback-start interval. For consecutive starts separated by h and age a at the earlier start, twice the integral is 2ah+h². Do not extrapolate beyond this interval. The scalar is a software availability proxy under dummy workload, not sensor exposure to actuator application.
coverage_and_checks.validation: All three derived CSVs reproduced byte-for-byte on a full second decode.
